test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In human males, the sex chromosomes present are XY. What is the difference between them?

options.text: There is no difference in size.
Y chromosome has more genes than X chromosome.
X-chromosome is bigger, whereas Y is smaller.
Y chromosome is bigger, whereas X is smaller.

solution:
The correct answer is __**X-chromosome is bigger, whereas Y is smaller.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **X chromosome **is **larger **than the **Y chromosome** in humans.
 
• The X chromosome contains **more genes** than the Y chromosome.
 
• The X chromosome plays a crucial role in determining the **sex of an individual**, as females have** two copies of the X** chromosome (XX) while males have **one X and one Y **chromosome (XY).
 
• The Y chromosome is responsible for the development of** male-specific characteristics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are **23 pairs of chromosomes** in humans.
 
• Only one pair, the **"Sex Chromosome,"** which actively participates in the process of determining a person's sex, is among these 23 pairings; the other 22 pairs are** autosomes.**
 
• Both sex chromosomal sets are carried by** males and females.**
 
• A few **plant species, animals, insects, and humans** all have the XY sex-determination system.
 
• Regardless of gender, every kid will receive an** X chromosome** from their **mother.** 
 
• Therefore, the type of** chromosome **that the offspring get from their **father** will decide their sex.
 
• A child with the **X** chromosome will be a **girl**, and a child with the** Y** chromosome will be a **male.**
